Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 3 points towards the Cavaliers.

analyst.text: This is a rematch four days after New York won 109-97 in Cleveland, the Knicks' fifth straight win over the Cavs. Marc Stein reports Kenny Atkinson's seat is warming after Cleveland lost four of five, including at a short-handed Charlotte, so expect an urgent response. The Knicks are on a back-to-back with Josh Hart doubtful, and Karl-Anthony Towns' stalled extension talks are a background distraction. On mood the lean is toward Cleveland's urgency, but the Knicks' recent dominance in this matchup is real.
